crossRefs.note: “These are of those who rebel against the light. They don’t know its ways, nor stay in its paths.
crossRefs.keyword: solitary. or, dark as the night

crossRefs.note: Behold, as wild donkeys in the desert, they go out to their work, seeking diligently for food. The wilderness yields…
of whom the world was not worthy—wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.

translations.web: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.
translations.bsb: Gaunt from poverty and hunger, they gnawed the dry land, and the desolate wasteland by night.
translations.kjv: For want and famine they were solitary; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste.
translations.asv: They are gaunt with want and famine; They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of wasteness and desolation.
